This package exposes a single callable, :func:`version_from_scm`, which
normalizes SCM-style version tags into a valid base version and incorporates
the distance from the tag, the working-tree dirty state, and the revision
node identifier.

import re

__all__ = ["version_from_scm"]

# Mirrors the default tag regex used by setuptools-scm to separate a leading
# project/namespace prefix from the actual version portion of an SCM tag.
_DEFAULT_TAG_REGEX = re.compile(
    r"^(?:[\w-]+-)?(?P<version>[vV]?\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2}[^\+]*)(?:\+.*)?$"
)
